description: Source code for the TTSSpeaker class and TTSConfiguration class, implementing a text-to-speech system with GStreamer pipeline management, configuration handling, and platform-specific audio controls.

classes.name: TTSConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for TTS settings including endpoints, voice, language, volume, and fallback options.

classes.name: TTSSpeaker
classes.description: Main class managing TTS speech synthesis, pipeline creation, playback, and client interaction.

methods.name: setSecureEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the secure TTS endpoint URL.

methods.name: setRFCEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the RFC TTS endpoint URL and enables RFC mode.

methods.name: setLocalEndPoint
methods.description: Sets the local TTS endpoint URL.

methods.name: setApiKey
methods.description: Sets the API key for TTS service.

methods.name: setEndpointType
methods.description: Sets the endpoint type (e.g., TTS1, TTS2).

methods.name: setLocalVoice
methods.description: Sets the local voice for TTS.

methods.name: setPrimVolDuck
methods.description: Sets the primary volume ducking level.

methods.name: voice
methods.description: Retrieves the voice setting, with fallback to defaults.

methods.name: localVoice
methods.description: Retrieves the local voice setting, with fallback to defaults.

methods.name: updateWith
methods.description: Updates current configuration with another configuration.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration is valid.

methods.name: hasValidLocalEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if a valid local endpoint is configured.
